title: Cadence Sprint: SE Lab & Flashproof Deck (Draft)
content:
Purpose: a compact, time-boxed slide set to train SEs and sellers on rapid pilot rhythms (the "Cadence Sprint") and a small library of "flashproof" one-page battle snippets for common objections. Audience: SEs, SDRs prepping technical pilots, and frontline sellers. Slide 1 — One-line thesis: "Ship a pilot in 7x7: seven plays across seven days to validate integration, latency, and unit economics." Speaker note: positioning versus long pilots; focus on measurable signals.

Slide 2 — Sprint outline (day-by-day):
- Day 0: baseline discovery checklist (integration points, SLA targets, data sensitivity)
- Day 1: smoke test + embed/endpoint proof of life (3 min demo)
- Day 2: latency microbench (90th percentile target, run 50 requests)
- Day 3: cost sanity (sample workload token count, batching suggestion)
- Day 4: quality sampling (10 prompts, compare model variants)
- Day 5: canary traffic + fallback wiring (route rules)
- Day 6: docs handoff + success metrics

Slide 3 — Flashproof: objection snippets (one-liners + technical pivot)
- "Latency is too high": show measured 90p, recommend dedicated pool or smaller model and outline rollback path to hosted variant.
- "Costs will explode": propose micro-batching + prefix caching, show expected % reduction and quick toggle.
- "We need on-prem": propose Private deployment phased approach: sandbox VPC first, then data plane cutover.
- "We can't handle regressions": call-out eval harness + nightly regression alerts; enable A/B canary with automatic rollback.

Slide 4 — Quick scripts for an SE demo (7 slides, 90s each):
- Script 0: 30s opener (value metric + topology)
- Script 1: live call to Hosted API (show trace and token counts)
- Script 2: swap model variant (switch quantized model) and show latency delta
- Script 3: toggle batching/caching and show cost estimate change
- Script 4: simulate partial failure and show fallback to compatible model
- Script 5: show console observability (per-route latency + cost)
- Script 6: next steps and runbook link

Slide 5 — Acceptance criteria (what success looks like at end of sprint):
- Integration: simple public endpoint or VPC handshake verified
- Latency: 90p within agreed threshold or documented fallback plan
- Cost: sample-run projected < target by model/batch tweaks or documented mitigation
- Quality: core 10 prompts pass customer-defined rubric; no critical hallucinations on PII queries
- Ops: alerting and rollback tested

Slide 6 — Tiny playbook snippets (copyable to Slack/email)
- Slack: "Run the 7x7 Cadence tomorrow — I can run the smoke and latency microbench in 30m. Ping me with an example prompt."
- Email to buyer: includes quick checklist, demo links, and expected outcomes in 1 paragraph.

Slide 7 — Measurement dashboard (what to capture in first week):
- Requests per minute, average token usage, 90p latency, cost per 1k tokens, regression score on prompt set, rollback events.

Slide 8 — Rapid fallback matrix (decision tree)
- If latency breach > SLO: swap to fallback model -> if persists, enable regional routing -> if persists, set degraded feature flag.
- If quality regression detected: revert to previous model version -> if persists, quarantine prompt set and open escalation.

Slide 9 — Handoff checklist for AE/CS after pilot is green:
- Document sample traffic and thresholds
- Attach eval results and model pinned version
- Confirm billing/contract trigger for Dedicated or Private
- Set next review cadence (30/60/90 days)

Appendix (play bank):
- Mini-battlecard: "Quantization tradeoffs" (talking points: cost vs. small semantic regressions, quick tests to detect regressions, recommended guardrails)
- Mini-battlecard: "KV caching wins" (examples: prompt templates, prefix cache hits, expected % latency drop)
- Quick links: Runbook URL, Eval harness PR, Canary checklist doc

Notes to self: keep slides highly skimmable; convert each flashproof into a one-paragraph snippet for seller Slack. Next: pilot with two SE volunteers (Matt R., Elyse K.) and iterate wording on objection snippets.

Last modified notes: added fallback matrix after talking with SRE on 2026-03-09.
